ap.title: UW-Green Bay - International student admission (apply, English proficiency, deadlines)

cost.title: UW-Green Bay - Cost (2026-27 tuition, housing, meal plan)

test_policy.notes: 'ACT and SAT test scores aren't required and won't impact your admission decision'; they can help with scholarships and course placement. Codes: ACT 4688, SAT 1859.

requirements.notes: Apply with the Universities of Wisconsin application. International applicants need the official secondary transcript, diploma or exam results (certified English translation if needed), an English proficiency score, a bank statement or letter and a signed financial support statement, and a passport copy. The $50 application fee comes from the Common Data Set; the international page does not mention it and instead lists a $50 International Student Processing Fee payable after acceptance, before the I-20 is issued.

deadlines.label: Last day to apply for fall 2027 (international students)
deadlines.notes: The page says international deadlines stay the same each year and prints no year, so fall 2027 is assumed. Documents to complete the application are due the next day (July 2). Spring: Dec. 1 (documents Dec. 2). The domestic first-year fall deadline is Aug. 23, 2027.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Scores must be no more than 2 years old. Other accepted proofs: ACT English+Reading combined 34 (neither below 17), SAT reading/writing 480+, Michigan English Test 53+, IGCSE (five C or higher), and Wisconsin ESL Institute (WESLI) level 600. Four years at a U.S. high school do not exempt a student. Waived for a U.S. post-secondary degree (or one from a listed English-speaking country), 15 transferable U.S. credits with a 2.5 GPA (transfer), or citizenship of a listed English-speaking country (e.g. Canada excluding Quebec, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa).

english.notes: For exams taken before Jan. 21, 2026. Institution code 1859.
For exams taken on or after Jan. 21, 2026.
IELTS must be shared with UW-Green Bay for online verification.
Share the score with UW-Green Bay through Duolingo.

cost.notes: Cost page for 2026-27: tuition and fees $9,133 for Wisconsin residents and $17,721 for out-of-state/non-resident students (fees included; international students pay the non-resident rate). Housing $4,854 plus meal plan $3,390 = $8,244 (as listed; the page does not say which room or plan). Books about $800; new student fee $217; optional parking $210. Extra fees $50 = one-time International Student Processing Fee after acceptance

aid.notes: Phoenix Scholar Award is an automatic tuition remission (not a scholarship or financial aid) for new first-year or transfer out-of-state and international students in in-person classes: Gold (100% of the non-resident portion of tuition) with SAT 1230+, ACT 26+ or GPA 3.51+; Green (75%) with SAT 1130-1220, ACT 23-25 or GPA 3.25-3.50. Dollar amounts for international students are not published; the page says to call or email. The Common Data Set marks both institutional need-based and non-need-based aid as available to nonresidents, but no international need-based program is described, so no aid policy is shown.
